entries.headline: A mail-in trade from Pokémon’s first era
entries.summary: This Charizard was offered through Japan’s 1998 Trade Please campaign. Collectors mailed the campaign flyer, any two Pokémon cards, and a return envelope to Media Factory; choosing Course A returned this unnumbered Charizard with the Trade Please! promotional card.
entries.later_history: Reference histories also record this Charizard print in the later Pokémon Song Best Collection release. A loose card does not by itself establish which distribution it came from.

source_refs.authority: Campaign dates, mail-in method, Course A contents, and later release context.
Japanese card identity, Ken Sugimori credit, and February 10, 1998 release context.

not_claiming: that a loose copy came from the 1998 campaign rather than a later distribution

policy.confidence: Attributed history is catalogue context supported by named references. It is not direct evidence about a seller’s physical copy.

not_claiming: complete historical coverage for every catalogue row
